gist.summary: The daily README update refreshed Latest News and the light and dark star-history charts. Recent Apps was not changed; it refreshes when an app is published.

image.prompt: Polli, wearing tiny reading glasses, checks a glowing README beside two star-history charts and a potted code-plant. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518).
